items.name: Termidor HE Termite Treatment
items.description: Trench and treat the soil around the full foundation perimeter with Termidor HE, creating a continuous treated zone that eliminates termites that pass through it.

items.name: Soil Pre-Treatment
items.description: Treat the soil under the planned addition or slab before it is poured, so new construction starts out protected against termites.

items.name: Fungus/Beetle Treatment
items.description: Treat exposed framing in the crawl space with a borate wood treatment to kill and prevent wood-decay fungus and wood-boring beetles.

items.name: DSV Fog (under 1,500 sq ft)
items.description: Fog the crawl space with DSV, a concentrated disinfectant, sanitizer, virucide, and fungicide, to kill bacteria, mildew, fungi, and viruses, including those spread by rodent droppings and urine (crawl spaces under 1,500 sq ft).

items.name: DSV Fog (over 1,500 sq ft)
items.description: Fog the crawl space with DSV, a concentrated disinfectant, sanitizer, virucide, and fungicide, to kill bacteria, mildew, fungi, and viruses, including those spread by rodent droppings and urine (crawl spaces over 1,500 sq ft).

items.name: Rubber Mulch (termite resistant)
items.description: Remove existing wood mulch from around the foundation, install weed barrier with a granular treatment, and replace with rubber mulch that will not feed termites.

items.name: Vapor Barrier (10 mil)
items.description: Install a 10 mil vapor barrier over the crawl space floor to block ground moisture.

items.name: Vapor Barrier (10 mil), taped seams
items.description: Install a 10 mil vapor barrier over the crawl space floor with all seams taped, to block ground moisture.

items.name: Vapor Barrier (12 mil woven)
items.description: Install a heavy-duty 12 mil reinforced woven vapor barrier over the crawl space floor to block ground moisture.

items.id: fallback:Vapor Barrier (12 mil woven), taped seams
items.name: Vapor Barrier (12 mil woven), taped seams
items.description: Install a heavy-duty 12 mil reinforced woven vapor barrier over the crawl space floor with all seams taped.

items.name: Vapor Barrier (20 mil)
items.description: Install a premium 20 mil reinforced vapor barrier over the crawl space floor, tough enough for crawl space foot traffic.

items.name: Vapor Barrier (20 mil), taped seams
items.description: Install a premium 20 mil reinforced vapor barrier over the crawl space floor with all seams taped.

items.name: Vapor Barrier Install Only
items.description: Install customer-supplied vapor barrier over the crawl space floor.

items.name: Vapor Barrier Removal Only
items.description: Remove and dispose of the old vapor barrier.

items.name: Dehumidifier (with electrician)
items.description: Install an Aprilaire crawl space dehumidifier, including a dedicated outlet installed by a licensed electrician, to keep humidity at safe levels year round.

items.name: Dehumidifier (no outlet needed)
items.description: Install an Aprilaire crawl space dehumidifier using the existing outlet, to keep humidity at safe levels year round.

items.name: Dehumidifier Swap (no electrician)
items.description: Replace the existing dehumidifier with a new Aprilaire unit.

items.name: Vent Covers
items.description: Seal foundation vents with insulated covers to keep dehumidified air in and humid outside air out of the crawl space.

items.name: Sump Pump (with electrician)
items.description: Install a sump pump with a dedicated outlet installed by a licensed electrician, discharging water away from the home.

items.name: Sump Pump (no electrician)
items.description: Install a sump pump using the existing outlet, discharging water away from the home.

items.name: Additional Sump Pump
items.description: Install an additional sump pump to handle the length of the drain system.

items.name: French Drain (outside)
items.description: Install an exterior French drain along the foundation to collect water and carry it away from the home.

items.name: French Drain (inside)
items.description: Install an interior French drain around the crawl space perimeter to collect water and direct it to the sump pump.

items.name: Screen Crawl Vents
items.description: Screen foundation vents to keep rodents and wildlife out of the crawl space.

items.name: Drip Edge (one story)
items.description: Install drip edge flashing along the roofline to direct rainwater away from the foundation and seal gaps where pests enter.

items.name: Custom Drip Edge (one story)
items.description: Install custom bent metal drip edge flashing to seal builder gaps along the roofline and direct water away from the home.

items.name: Siding Shield
items.description: Install siding shield flashing along the bottom of the siding to keep water and pests out.

items.name: Full Encapsulation (with foam board insulation)
items.description: Complete crawl space encapsulation: 20 mil vapor barrier sealed to the walls with taped seams, foam board on the walls, vent covers, an Aprilaire dehumidifier with electrician, and a fungus treatment.
items.rep_notes: Add ~12 sq ft per pier for pier wrapping. Over 2,500 sq ft may need an additional dehumidifier.

items.name: Full Encapsulation (no foam board insulation)
items.description: Complete crawl space encapsulation: 20 mil vapor barrier sealed to the walls with taped seams, vent covers, an Aprilaire dehumidifier with electrician, and a fungus treatment.
items.rep_notes: Add ~12 sq ft per pier for pier wrapping. Over 2,500 sq ft may need an additional dehumidifier.

items.name: Crawl Space Insulation Install (R19)
items.description: Install R-19 insulation between the floor joists to keep floors warmer and lower energy costs.
items.rep_notes: By section: 1 batt is about 9 sq ft

items.name: Crawl Space Insulation Removal
items.description: Remove and dispose of old, damaged, or fallen crawl space insulation.
items.rep_notes: Sheet lists $1.75 with no unit; assumed per sq ft

items.name: Crawl Space Insulation Removal + Install
items.description: Remove old crawl space insulation and install new R-19 insulation between the floor joists.

items.name: Floor Joist
items.description: Sister damaged floor joists with new treated lumber to restore strength to the floor.

items.name: Sill Plate (under 8 ft)
items.description: Replace damaged sill plate (under 8 ft per section) with new treated lumber where the house framing sits on the foundation.

items.name: Band Board (first 3 sections)
items.description: Replace damaged band board (rim joist) with new treated lumber, first 3 sections.

items.name: Band Board (each section after 3)
items.description: Replace additional sections of damaged band board (rim joist) with new treated lumber.

items.name: Beam
items.description: Replace the damaged beam (the main support under the floor joists) with new treated lumber to restore support to the floor system.

items.name: Subfloor Section
items.description: Replace a damaged section of subfloor from below with new material.

items.name: Subfloor Remove & Replace (top down)
items.description: Remove damaged subfloor from above and install new subfloor, including demolition and new board. Replacing the finished flooring (carpet, tile, hardwood, or vinyl) is the homeowner's responsibility.

items.name: Dumpster Fee (large demo)
items.description: Dumpster and disposal of debris from the demolition work.

items.name: New Crawl Vent
items.description: Install a new crawl space foundation vent.

items.name: New Crawl Door
items.description: Install a new, tight-fitting crawl space access door.

items.id: fallback:New Crawl Door with Frame / Custom
items.name: New Crawl Door with Frame / Custom
items.description: Build and install a custom crawl space access door with a new frame.

items.name: Attic Insulation R-49 (13 in), removal 10 in or less
items.description: Remove existing attic insulation (10 in or less), then install Pro-Shield pest-control insulation to R-49 (about 13 in), the Department of Energy recommended level. Pro-Shield is treated with boric acid for lasting pest control and added fire resistance.

items.id: fallback:Attic Insulation R-49 (13 in), removal over 10 in
items.name: Attic Insulation R-49 (13 in), removal over 10 in
items.description: Remove existing attic insulation (over 10 in), then install Pro-Shield pest-control insulation to R-49 (about 13 in), the Department of Energy recommended level. Pro-Shield is treated with boric acid for lasting pest control and added fire resistance.

items.id: fallback:Attic Insulation Cap (6 in), install only
items.name: Attic Insulation Cap (6 in), install only
items.description: Add a 6 in layer of Pro-Shield pest-control insulation over the existing insulation to improve comfort and energy efficiency.

items.name: Termite Warranty
items.description: Annual termite re-treatment warranty: a yearly inspection, and re-treatment if termites return. This warranty covers re-treatment only; it does not cover repair of termite damage.

items.name: Dehumidifier Maintenance
items.description: Service visit every 6 months: clean the dehumidifier, change the filter, and change tubing if needed. Talent-installed units only. Includes a yearly inspection.

items.name: Encapsulation Warranty
items.description: One-year encapsulation warranty: we repair any rips or tears in the vapor barrier. With an ongoing plan that includes rodent protection, we also keep the encapsulated crawl space rodent free. Does not cover wood that cracks or "dry rots" as it dries out (see Terms).

items.name: Mosquito (stand-alone)
items.description: Mosquito treatment around the yard during mosquito season, March through October. Includes a yearly inspection.

items.name: One-Time Pest Service (not advertised)
items.description: One-time interior and exterior pest treatment. No guarantee.

items.name: Misc Hourly Work
items.description: Additional labor as described, billed per person, per hour.
